comment: Boundary probes for performance targets and claims in new or existing code, including review, versus unknown-cause diagnosis, design choices with no target, and speculative optimization.

queries.query: Use $performance-engineering to profile the importer and prove whether the proposed optimization reduces runtime.
Reduce API p99 latency from 450 ms to under 250 ms at 1,000 requests per second without using more than 10% additional memory.
Peak resident memory during the supplied corpus import must stay below 512 MiB. Profile allocations, improve it, and show before-and-after evidence.
Write the new thumbnail service so p99 stays under 150 ms at 500 requests per second on the staging hardware, and show the numbers.
Review this pull request that claims the parser is 40% faster; check whether its benchmark actually supports that claim.
The service suddenly became slow after yesterday's deployment and we do not know why. Find the cause.
Add a deduplication step to this ingestion command; inputs can reach a few million records.
Replace every nested loop in the repository because O(n squared) is always too slow.
A profile already identifies this behavior-neutral allocation path as the bottleneck. Restructure it and verify the p95 and memory effects against the baseline.
